verdict.rationale: Cognee is explicitly open source and documented to run fully self-hosted: docker run instructions, local UI via cognee.start_ui() with no account required, and CLI/demo modes that work offline. Pricing page explicitly states 'Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever,' confirming the core product (not a crippled tier) can be self-hosted. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full self-hosted deployment beyond docs/probes.
